<h1>Elvis Kwame Ofori</h1>

<p class="hero-role">Agricultural, land-use and policy modeller</p>

<p class="hero-lead">I develop economic, spatial, behavioural and computational models to understand how climate, agricultural, land-use and bioenergy policies move from national objectives to real production systems, farms and places.</p>

<p class="hero-lead">My work asks where adjustment occurs, who and what is exposed, which alternatives are feasible, and how policy design changes implementation outcomes.</p>

<section class="home-section">
<div class="section-heading">
<div class="section-label">Research</div>
<h2>From national targets to the economics and geography of implementation.</h2>
</div>

<p class="research-statement">A national pathway can be technically feasible and still be difficult to implement locally. My research connects aggregate targets with heterogeneous farms, production systems, land resources and places so that policy design can be tested before major decisions are locked in.</p>
</section>
